brief: 5 burnout warning signs every founder ignores until it's too late.

slots.body: Burnout doesn't announce itself. It builds quietly until your performance and health collapse without warning.

slots.title: The Crash Is Silent
slots.body: High performers ignore exhaustion until the cost becomes irreversible. Founders pride themselves on grinding through the warning signals.
slots.calloutBody: Recovery takes ten times longer than prevention, so watch for the early signals daily.

slots.title: Sleep Stops Refreshing You
slots.body: You log eight hours but wake up foggy and drained. Rest feels like a pause, not recovery.
slots.calloutBody: Schedule one full recovery day weekly with zero meetings or investor calls.

slots.title: Your Mission Feels Pointless
slots.body: Projects that once excited you now feel like meaningless chores. Cynicism replaces the passion that built your startup.
slots.calloutBody: Reconnect with your original customer story to remember why you started.

slots.title: Simple Decisions Paralyze You
slots.body: You stare at emails for hours unable to hit send. Cognitive fatigue masks itself as procrastination and self-doubt.
slots.calloutBody: Batch decisions into morning blocks before willpower reserves deplete completely.

slots.title: You Isolate Without Realizing
slots.body: You skip investor updates and dodge cofounder dinners entirely. Withdrawal feels like focus but it is actually self-preservation gone wrong.
slots.calloutBody: Book one honest conversation with a peer or mentor before Friday ends.

slots.title: Your Body Sends Signals
slots.body: Headaches, gut issues, and tension appear every single morning. Stress stored in the body eventually demands to be addressed.
slots.calloutBody: Get a blood panel and commit to thirty minutes of movement daily.

slots.body: Burnout is a systems failure, not a personal one. Build recovery into your operating rhythm before the crash.
